title: Some Americans Are Making ‘Choices Between Necessities,’ Retailers Warn
summary: Retail earnings this week so far paint a mixed picture—both about how U.S. consumers are faring and how large retailers are navigating those waters.  Target and Walmart, mainstream retailers that sell a range of goods including groceries, both reported higher sales, but flagged that shoppers continue to be cautious, in part because of higher gas prices.  Target said comparable sales rose 3.8% in the most recent quarter, its second quarter of solid growth after enduring a yearslong string of weak quarterly sales results.
